tools.compare_windows: Identity check: compare two refs using independent actual boundary sightings, or two explicit ranges; intent correspondence_check. Not a continuous observed path. Spends one of the active case's Gemma calls.
tools.context_get: Read the active readable case card: original goal, known facts, unresolved question, answer impact, existing evidence, a suggested first step and this case's Gemma budget. No inference.
tools.inspect_window: Ask a factual visual question about ref. appearance_check (body color; marked full image plus crop; next_best selects a different actual frame), scene_check (roadway layout), visibility_check (occlusion/co-visibility only), position_check (location only). Spends one of the active case's Gemma calls. Optional start/end frames must be paired.
tools.investigation_finish: End the exact active case. Supply case_ref, outcome and O/E observation_refs; finding is same/different for identity, a verbatim O color for appearance, single for resolved layout or multiple for unsupported layout. Unresolved may omit finding. No note or legacy result fields.
tools.observation_get: Read one current V/T/O/E/cursor reference or inventory, detections, unmatched. detections/unmatched defaults to active-case frames; optional frames narrows. Summary is readable; raw gives actual bbox details, never confidence/predictions. No new inference.
